about: The answer key for the documents-map samples: the proposals a correct run makes from trace.json on a graph whose ontology is sampleOntology of samples.ts (Room, Equipment, SpecSection; HAS_EQUIPMENT from Room to Equipment, SPECIFIED_IN from Room to SpecSection) and that holds no instance of them yet.
All text is invented. Entries are named by their document and identifier; a room is a page entry made from the room sheet's own number in the head of its page.

instances: each entry a link needs is a new instance of its class, proposed as four statements: its rdf:type, its rdfs:label, its identifier, and the DENOTES link from its entry (a DocEntry, or the DocMention of a room number).

facts: each link of the trace is one statement from the room of its page to the instance of the entry it names, 15 in all. A correct run makes these 15 facts and no other: 75 proposals with the 60 statements of the instances.
leave_out: what a correct run does not propose.

leave_out.reason: No file defines M 7, so its mention has no link: no instance and no fact.
The equipment list defines it, but no room sheet names it: no link needs its instance.
The specification defines it, but no room sheet names it.
A measure: a mention without a link.
A standard outside the project: a mention without a link.
